snippet.title: About Frontlines: Announce Teaser
snippet.description:
Hey I'm Luca, solo-creator of About Frontlines.

About Frontlines is a turn-based strategy game built on total freedom. Design your own maps, forge your own units, and set your own rules of war. Build and play every era you can imagine. Quick, tense, tactical battles against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

Follow the channel or wishlist the game on Steam to stay updated with the work in progress!
